# Isaiah Chapter 11 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 146r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/ISA_011_page_001.jpg

---

## Consensus Translation

**11:1** And-a-shoot choter will-go-out veyatsa from-the-stump mi-geza of-Yishai Jesse, and-a-branch netser from-his-roots mi-shorashav will-bear-fruit yifreh.

**11:6** And-the-wolf ze'ev will-dwell vegar with-the-lamb keves, and-the-leopard namer with-the-kid gedi will-lie-down yirbats; and-the-calf egel and-the-young-lion kefiyr and-the-fatling u-meri together yachdav — and-a-little-child na'ar qaton leading noheg them.

**11:9** They-will-not harm lo yare'u and-will-not destroy lo yashchitu in-all my-holy qodshi mountain har; for the-earth ha-arets will-be-full male'ah of-the-knowledge de'ah of-YHWH as-the-waters ka-mayim covering mekhassim the-sea la-yam.

---
## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah 11 — "The Branch from Jesse" — part of First Isaiah (chs.1-39), rooted in the 8th-century BCE Assyrian crisis. The chapter contributes to Isaiah's overarching vision: YHWH as the Holy One of Israel who judges his people but promises ultimate restoration.

---
